missions.name: Dead Stock Analysis
missions.query: What products have a stock count of 0 at all locations and were not reordered in the last 30 days?

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Comparison
missions.query: What suppliers have a lead time greater than the average lead time across all suppliers?

missions.name: Sizing Anomaly Detection
missions.query: What product styles have a size distribution skew greater than 2 standard deviations from the mean?

missions.name: Reorder Point Breach Analysis
missions.query: What products have a stock count less than their reorder point at any location and were not reordered in the last 30 days?

missions.name: Supplier Delay Analysis
missions.query: What products have a supplier lead time greater than 30 days and were not reordered in the last 30 days?

missions.name: Return Cause Analysis
missions.query: What products have a high return rate (> 20%) in the last 30 days?

missions.name: Supplier Performance Monitoring
missions.query: What suppliers have an on-time rate less than 90% in the last 30 days?

missions.name: Demand Level Monitoring
missions.query: What products have a sales volume greater than 2 standard deviations from the mean in the last 30 days?
